n: 30-inch Gas Cooktop with EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged Cast-Iron Grates
desc: Get dinner on the table fast with greater Cooking Flexibility thanks to various burner sizes and power levels, and Edge-to-Edge Cast Iron Grates. Use the SpeedHeat™ Burner as a quick boil burner and the 5K BTU Simmer Burner for low, even heat.
hl: Get a rapid boil and perfect sear quickly with the SpeedHeat™ Burner, which generates high heat to get dinner to the table fast.
Navigate busy mealtimes with various burner sizes and a range of power levels, so you can simmer your sauce while you sear your steaks to maximize time in the kitchen.
Get quick access to spills on the cooktop with our industry-first EZ-2-Lift™ Hinged Cast-Iron Grates.
Easily maintain low, even heat to simmer your sauces, warm up leftovers or melt chocolate with the 5K BTU Simmer Burner.
Get a variety of heating power with your multi-purpose burners.
Wash these cast-iron grates right in the dishwasher when they get messy, thanks to a dishwasher-safe finish that makes them easy to clean.
spec: Cast Iron Grates; Continuous with Hinge; Dishwasher Safe; Matte Finish
ADA Height and Side Reach Compliant
